coach_lines.hyrox-conditioning: I built this hour on the HYROX race format: HIIT, functional moves, endurance. Join me at {time}.
coach_lines.off-court-training: I designed this hour for performance and injury prevention. Racket player or not, join me at {time}.
coach_lines.boxercise-beginner: I teach boxing with no contact, for strength and speed. New is fine; start with me at {time}.
coach_lines.boxercise-advanced: My no-contact boxing at the advanced level, for agility and endurance. Come box with me at {time}.
coach_lines.booty-and-core: Every level is welcome here, beginners too. We work on strength and flexibility. Join me at {time}.
coach_lines.body-sculpt: I mix strength and cardio in one full-body hour. Come work through it with me at {time}.
coach_lines.booty: It's Booty with me, one hour at {time}. Come along; I'd love to have you there.
coach_lines.stretching: An hour of stretching with me at {time}. I'll save you a spot.
coach_lines.mobility: An hour of mobility with me at {time}. I'd be glad to see you there.
coach_lines.injury-prevention-mobility: My new class works on injury prevention and mobility. I'd love you to join me at {time}.

coach_lines_note: COPY.md v1.3 SHEET.coach.<class-id>; {time} is the class start time; Sample until each coach approves the line.

reviews.text: …There’s a great variety of classes to suit everyone, and the trainers are friendly, knowledgeable, and always happy to help.
Excellent gym with top-level equipment, a great range of classes…
…The variety of classes offered is amazing, The trainers are absolute experts, providing guidance and motivation in every session.
Awesome gym and amazing spa area. Great variety of classes and equipment is exceptional .
…I joined the boxercise class 3x a week with Rey who is brilliant.
…classes are great, tinos’ mobility sorted me out…
…rey’s hyrox conditioning class is a monster.
…Ray delivered the lesson at a very high level with terrific dedication.
…the energy of the coaches - Icha, Rey, Tinos - that just really makes you want to work harder!

reviews_note: REAL Google reviews, verbatim (typos, lowercase and … kept): Google Maps reviews read via Firecrawl on 28 Oct 2026, 172 of 497 reviews (ef-gf/s3v2/reviews/REVIEWS.md v1.1). tags.hero = the hero rotator, in file order; tags.coach/classes = the booking sheet (class match first, then coach).
